Interface Easing

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Easing
An easing curve (7.4.0): eased progress for a linear progress t, both from 0 to 1. A Transition runs one; any function of t with f(0) = 0 and f(1) = 1 is one, so a mod can pass its own as a lambda.
